actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in this analytics dashboard project and your scope looks like a great fit.

A few quick questions so I can prepare a proposal:
• Can you share an overview of the REST API (auth method, rate limits, example endpoints) and whether a staging API is available?
• For “real-time” charts, what latency/refresh expectations do you have (e.g., streaming via websockets, polling every N seconds)?
• How many user roles and distinct permission levels do you expect for role-based access control?
• Do you have any existing design system or Figma files for visual/UX requirements, or should I include UI design time in the estimate?
• Is the $5k–$6k budget flexible depending on scope (especially for real-time streaming, auth complexity, or additional pages)?

I’m available to start next month and can block 10–20 hours/week depending on timeline. If that works, I’m happy to hop on a short call (30 minutes) to align on requirements and deliverables — please share a few times that suit you.

Looking forward to your answers — thanks again!

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer • TechCorp Inc.
Portfolio: jordanmitchell.dev
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jordanmitchell
